title: Trust in the plan
preview: And when you have decided, rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely upon Him.
content:
# Trust in the plan

**"And when you have decided, rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely upon Him."**

— *Quran 3:159*

Do your part with sincerity and effort, then place the outcome in Allah’s hands. Tawakkul is not inaction – it’s doing your best and trusting the rest to the One who knows what is best.

---

*Reference: Surah Ali 'Imran, 3:159*

title: With hardship comes ease
preview: Indeed, with hardship comes ease. So when you have finished, strive. And to your Lord turn your attention.
content:
# With hardship comes ease

**"Indeed, with hardship comes ease."**

— *Quran 94:5–6*

Allah repeats this twice in the same surah. No difficulty lasts forever. After every trial there is relief – so keep going, and when you are done with your duty, turn to your Lord in gratitude and hope.

---

*Reference: Surah Ash-Sharh, 94:5-8*

title: Remember Me, I will remember you
preview: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
content:
# Remember Me, I will remember you

**"So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me."**

— *Quran 2:152*

Dhikr is a direct conversation with Allah. When you remember Him in your heart and on your tongue, He remembers you with mercy and care. Gratitude and remembrance are the keys to a heart at peace.

---

*Reference: Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:152*

title: The best among you
preview: The best among you are those who have the best character.
content:
# The best among you

**"The best among you are those who have the best character."**

— *Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)*

Not wealth, status, or tribe – character. Kindness, honesty, patience, and keeping your word. This is the measure that matters in the sight of Allah and in the lives of those around you.

---

*Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Sunan Abi Dawud*

title: Do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah
preview: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
content:
# Do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah

**"Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."**

— *Quran 39:53*

No matter how far you have strayed, Allah’s mercy is greater. Turn back to Him, ask for forgiveness, and never think you are beyond His pardon. This verse is a door that never closes.

---

*Reference: Surah Az-Zumar, 39:53*
